diagnosis_sampling.selection_order: SHA256 seed+record within partition, without looking at labels

abstention_thresholds: class-specific lower/upper thresholds chosen on calibration fold9 only; require >=95% sensitivity for negative bound and >=90% positive predictive value for positive bound with >=10 relevant examples; unsupported bounds disabled

delineation.split_order: SHA256 seed+record; LUDB one record per subject per source documentation; QTDB independent database without subject linkage
delineation.model: extra-trees regressors for annotated P/QRS/T onset and offset conditioned on a matched R peak
delineation.comparator: NeuroKit2 DWT delineation, no fitting to test

activation: research only unless all gates including clinical image validation pass; no automatic production installation
